mapper.select: SELECT id,store_id,merchant_id,current_aftersale_id,version,order_stage,verification_status,aftersale_status,verified_at,completed_at FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_operation_guard WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='ACQUIRED'
mapper.update: UPDATE order_operation_guard SET status=#{status},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token=#{token} AND order_id=#{order} AND operation_type='VERIFY' AND status='ACQUIRED'

UPDATE pet_order SET order_stage='COMPLETED',verification_status='VERIFIED',verified_at=#{at},completed_at=#{at},aftersale_status=#{aftersaleStatus},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND order_stage='PENDING_SERVICE' AND verification_status='UNVERIFIED' AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND verified_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
